sources.notes: Broad tactile-in-embodied-robotics framing requires sensor, representation, policy, whole-body, evaluation, and deployment surfaces beyond the static tactile-force family.

queries.label: dynamic-tactile-foundation-representation
queries.query: (all:tactile OR all:haptic) AND (all:"foundation model" OR all:pretraining OR all:representation) AND all:robot
queries.why: Capture tactile encoders, pretrained representations, and generalist tactile models.

queries.label: dynamic-tactile-vla-policy
queries.query: (all:tactile OR all:touch OR all:haptic) AND (all:"vision language action" OR all:VLA OR all:policy) AND all:robot
queries.why: Capture tactile injection into VLA and visuomotor policy stacks.

queries.label: dynamic-tactile-world-action-model
queries.query: (all:tactile OR all:touch) AND (all:"world model" OR all:"world action model" OR all:prediction) AND all:manipulation
queries.why: Capture predictive contact models and inference-time action verification.

queries.label: dynamic-tactile-dexterous-soft
queries.query: (all:tactile OR all:touch) AND (all:dexterous OR all:"deformable object" OR all:insertion OR all:assembly) AND all:robot
queries.why: Capture contact-rich dexterous, deformable, insertion, and assembly task evidence.

queries.label: dynamic-robot-skin-whole-body
queries.query: (all:"robot skin" OR all:e-skin OR all:"whole-body tactile" OR all:"foot contact") AND (all:humanoid OR all:robot)
queries.why: Capture large-area tactile skin, humanoid body contact, and locomotion-contact sensing.

queries.label: dynamic-tactile-dataset-benchmark
queries.query: (all:tactile OR all:visuotactile) AND (all:dataset OR all:benchmark OR all:evaluation) AND all:robot
queries.why: Capture datasets, benchmarks, cross-sensor evaluation, and safety metrics.

queries.label: dynamic-tactile-calibration-drift
queries.query: (all:tactile OR all:force) AND (all:calibration OR all:drift OR all:wear OR all:"cross-sensor") AND all:robot
queries.why: Capture sensor-instance transfer, calibration, drift, wear, and maintenance limitations.

queries.label: dynamic-tactile-negative-evidence
queries.query: (all:tactile OR all:haptic) AND (all:failure OR all:limitation OR all:latency OR all:noise) AND all:"robot manipulation"
queries.why: Capture explicit negative results and deployment constraints.

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-tactile-robotics-browser
browser_fallback_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs (tactile OR visuotactile OR haptic) robot manipulation 2025 2026
browser_fallback_queries.why: Browser fallback for broad recent tactile robotics discovery.

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-tactile-calibration-web
web_calibration_queries.query: tactile robotics 2026 dataset world model VLA robot skin
web_calibration_queries.why: Find fresh method aliases and benchmark names before finalizing search terms.
